current_text.html: All funds received by the Corporation that are designated for the benefit of any particular permanent Committee or Agency shall be disbursed by the treasurer to the proper Committee or Agency. There shall be no equalization of funds so designated. Any funds received by the Corporation not designated as being for the benefit of a particular permanent Committee or Agency shall be distributed by the treasurer as directed by the General Assembly.

relationships.title: SJC member eligibility for concurrent GA agency board service

metadata.summary: The CCB advised that a member of the GA's Standing Judicial Commission is eligible to serve concurrently on the board of a General Assembly agency.
